items.title: IonQ Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: IonQ said it was raising full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $260 million-$270 million and Q2 guidance to $65 million-$68 million; it also said remaining performance obligations grew 554% year-on-year to $470 million.

items.title: IonQ Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: IonQ reported $130.0 million of annual revenue and said it expected full-year 2026 revenue between $225 million and $245 million at that time; it also cited strong organic growth and commercial traction.

items.title: 2025 Annual Report
items.snippet: SEC annual report includes risk-factor discussion mentioning dependence on market and business conditions, financing liquidity needs, and that investments and networking technology may reduce the value of common stock.
